profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
My name is Naima Jackson and I am a Software Engineer with 3 years of experience building and maintaining scalable web applications. I am skilled in C#, Angular, Blazor, Aurelia, Microsoft SQL Server, and Azure. I'm Passionate about designing user-friendly interfaces that are both beautiful and functional, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions on time and within budget, and  continuously learning and exploring new technologies to stay ahead of the curve. I am looking to leverage my skills at a company where I can make a real impact, and I am eager to contribute to a fast-paced team where I can leverage my skills to develop innovative solutions. 

CHECK OUT MY GITHUB https://github.com/naimajackson51 :)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I am a Full Stack Developer at ImagineSoftware and I have a genuine passion for helping others and solving problems. I currently work in the .NET space with a specialization in SQL, Angular, and C# languages. I have experience with troubleshooting code bugs, thoroughly testing code solutions, and implementing efficient solutions to complex coding problems in medical billing technology. Please feel free to connect, I love to meet new people and help others in any way I can.
